evidence_summary: Final live run sent a ConfigNode V2 Pipe handshake containing only a foreign cluster ID and timestamp precision; it contained no username/password and opened no IoTDB session. The target returned status_code=200. On the same unauthenticated transport, the harness sent a serialized CreateDatabase ConfigPhysicalPlan for root.unauth_poc and received status_code=200. The target ConfigNode log records successful handshake and ClusterSchemaManager entries for root.unauth_poc.
reason: The public DataNode client RPC Pipe endpoint forwarded an unauthenticated ConfigNode Pipe request and executed a privileged database-creation plan. This demonstrates the reported authentication/authorization bypass against the supplied IoTDB 1.3.3 vulnerable runtime.
iterations: Corrected the client framing to IoTDB TElasticFramedTransport after the server rejected unframed Thrift traffic.
Sent a valid anonymous ConfigNode V2 handshake without credentials; the runtime returned 200.
Replaced a malformed plan probe with a serialized CreateDatabase plan; the runtime returned 200 and recorded root.unauth_poc.
